Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Nazr Mohammed?

Nazr Mohammed is 48 years old.

Where was Nazr Mohammed born?

Nazr Mohammed was born in Chicago, Illinois.

When was Nazr Mohammed born?

Nazr Mohammed was born on September 5, 1977.

How tall is Nazr Mohammed?

Nazr Mohammed is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Nazr Mohammed weigh when playing?

Nazr Mohammed weighed 221 lbs (100 kg) when playing.

Is Nazr Mohammed in the Hall of Fame?

Nazr Mohammed is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Nazr Mohammed drafted?

Nazr Mohammed was drafted by Utah Jazz, 1st round (29th pick, 29th overall), 1998 NBA Draft.

What position did Nazr Mohammed play?

Center.

When did Nazr Mohammed retire?

Nazr Mohammed last played in 2016.

What is Nazr Mohammed's net worth?

Nazr Mohammed made at least $65,514,968 playing professional basketball.

How much did Nazr Mohammed make?

Nazr Mohammed made $6,883,800 in 2011.

What did Nazr Mohammed average?

Nazr Mohammed averaged 5.8 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 0.4 assists per game.

How many rings does Nazr Mohammed have?

Nazr Mohammed won one championship.

What schools did Nazr Mohammed attend?

Nazr Mohammed attended Kenwood in Chicago, Illinois and Kentucky.

What are Nazr Mohammed's nicknames?

Naz, Nasty, Big Nasty, Big Z are nicknames for Nazr Mohammed.
